name: Nha Trang
tagline: Beach city of islands, mud baths and Cham towers
summary: Nha Trang is Vietnam's beach capital, with a long sandy bay, islands to hop and a lively seafront. Visit the Po Nagar Cham Towers, soak in mineral mud baths, snorkel or dive at Hon Mun and ride the cable car to the island amusement park.
seasonNote: February to August is dry and sunny; October to December brings heavy rain.
arrival: Cam Ranh Airport is 40 minutes south.
gettingAround: Grab, taxis and walking the seafront.
cashTip: Cash is king at street stalls; cards work in hotels and bigger restaurants. Grab is cashless.
foodTip: Fish noodle soup (bún chả cá) and nem nướng.
